name: Deck inflates the market by roughly an order of magnitude
description: The deck claims an $88B market at 31% CAGR. The corpus puts the whole category at $6-8B and the mid-market slice at $900M-1.3B, growing 14-18%. A correct analysis catches the gap and does not accept the deck's denominator. It should also raise BlackLine, Trintech and the bundled ERP modules, none of which the deck names — it lists only 'spreadsheets'.

claims.rationale: The corpus explicitly says figures above $80B roll up the entire office-of-the-CFO stack, and puts the relevant slice two orders of magnitude lower.

blind_spots.rationale: The corpus names both as incumbents moving down-market. The deck's only listed competitor is 'spreadsheets'.
The corpus notes reconciliation ships bundled with the ERP this buyer already runs — the classic absorption risk.
